# Diana Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** Seventeen or eighteen years old  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c26 P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004), [v1 c31 P15](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0015), [v1 c33 P13](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0013)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P15](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0015)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002), [v4 c2 P16](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0016)</sub>
- **Origin:** Orchard Slope, Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014)</sub>
- **Role:** Housewife and mother  <sub>[v3 c39 P41](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0041), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Di  <sub>[v1 c18 P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025)</sub>

## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty girl with black eyes, rosy cheeks, and black hair worn in curls. She is known for her merry expression and enchanting dimples. As she grows older, she becomes somewhat plump and matronly.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c33 P13](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0013), [v1 c33 P14](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0014), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)_

## Personality

Diana is cheerful, practical, and good-natured, with a warm and affectionate heart. Though less imaginative than her closest friend, she is an eager listener who appreciates creativity and romance. She is loyal to those she loves, though occasionally anxious about propriety and social expectations.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005), [v1 c21 P17](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0017), [v1 c26 P18](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0018), [v2 c2 P9](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0009)_

## Goals

- To be a faithful, lifelong friend to Anne Shirley  <sub>[v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c17 P4](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0004), [v1 c17 P9](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0009)</sub>
- To build a happy home with Fred Wright and care for her family  <sub>[v2 c29 P24](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0024), [v2 c29 P28](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0028), [v3 c39 P47](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0047)</sub>

## History

Diana Barry grows up at Orchard Slope near Green Gables and becomes Anne Shirley's bosom friend after taking a solemn vow of eternal loyalty. Their early friendship faces a trial when Diana accidentally drinks currant wine at Green Gables, leading her mother to temporarily forbid them from playing together. The friendship is fully restored after Anne helps save Diana's little sister, Minnie May, during a bout of croup. Diana attends Avonlea School alongside Anne, participating in the Story Club, the Debating Club concert, and the school's Christmas performance. She later attends Queen's Academy, though she chooses not to pursue a teaching career. After completing her studies, Diana settles in Avonlea and becomes engaged to Fred Wright. They marry in a grand ceremony at Orchard Slope, with Anne serving as her bridesmaid. The couple makes their home in Avonlea, where Diana gives birth to her children, including her eldest son, Fred, and a daughter named Small Anne Cordelia.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P28](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0028), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c16 P45](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0045), [v1 c16 P59](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0059), [v1 c18 P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025), [v1 c18 P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 c18 P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v2 c29 P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v3 c39 P41](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0041), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002), [v4 c4 P1](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0001), [v4 c4 P15](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0015)_

## Background by volume

- Grew up at Orchard Slope in Avonlea as the daughter of George and Mrs. Barry  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014)</sub>
- Attended Avonlea School and Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020)</sub>
- Accidentally became intoxicated on Marilla's currant wine, causing a temporary ban on her friendship with Anne  <sub>[v1 c16 P45](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0045), [v1 c16 P49](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0049), [v1 c16 P59](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0059)</sub>
- Saved her sister Minnie May's life alongside Anne during a severe attack of croup  <sub>[v1 c18 P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 c18 P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043)</sub>

## Quotes

> I solemnly swear to be faithful to my bosom friend, Anne Shirley, as long as the sun and moon shall endure.  <sub>[v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035)</sub>

> Indeed I will, and I’ll never have another bosom friend—I don’t want to have. I couldn’t love anybody as I love you.  <sub>[v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005)</sub>

> I shall never love anybody . . . any girl . . . half as well as I love you. And if I ever do marry and have a little girl of my own I’m going to name her Anne.  <sub>[v2 c26 P60](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0060)</sub>

> Married life has its ups and downs, of course. You mustn’t expect that everything will always go smoothly. But I can assure you, Anne, that it’s a happy life, when you’re married to the right man.  <sub>[v4 c1 P6](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0006)</sub>

> We are not really parting, Anne. I’m not going far away. We’ll love each other just as much as ever. We’ve always kept that ‘oath’ of friendship we swore long ago, haven’t we?  <sub>[v4 c3 P3](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0003)</sub>
